title: freeze_experts assigned in __init__ instead of dataclass field — OmegaConf merge dropped it
trigger_conditions: any CLI override applied via Config.merge
root_cause: FreezeTransformerTrainModuleConfig set self.freeze_experts via kwargs.pop in __init__ rather than declaring it as a dataclass field. Config.merge serializes/reconstructs through OmegaConf, which drops fields that aren't declared dataclass attributes; freeze_experts always reverted to the default 'first_half' regardless of the user's configured value, silently zeroing the first half of router gradients.
invariant: Every user-tunable Config attribute must be a dataclass field so OmegaConf serialization preserves it through merge/dump.
diff_summary: Drop the custom __init__ and declare freeze_experts: str = 'first_half' as a proper dataclass field.
silent_check: Training proceeds without error — the wrong freeze_experts value silently masks router gradients in a way that's only visible by inspecting that the user's configured value was ignored.
